evidence.irr: 『each defined medical device that we market must first receive either premarket notification clearance (510(k))』+磁場15,000ガウス安全設計=FDA認証・MRI安全規格ロック→85
evidence.rep: 『Roger Susi...invented the first MRI compatible patient monitoring system in 1986 and the first non-magnetic MRI compatible IV infusion pump system in 2004』+『patented Tru Sense』+『complex manufacturing processes and involve long lead times』=20年超先行+特許+非磁性製造知→極困難80

evidence.erosion: 『Our failure to renew contracts with GPOs may cause us to lose market share』(条件付きGPO更新リスク)+監視装置に既存競合。中核ポンプ独占は維持だが周縁で圧力→emerging

evidence.moatdecay: 売上21.5%5年CAGR継続・独占製品維持・新製品MRidium 3870が2025/5にFDA 510(k)取得→no
